summary: The background loop's inbox is renamed to avoid clashing with Signal.
details: The cognition loop's per-unit inbox row, added days ago behind [cognition] mode = "off", is now called a stimulus (plural stimuli) instead of a signal, because "signal" collided with Signal, the messaging platform Nora lives on. The database table, its metrics (nora_stimulus_total, nora_stimulus_pending_age_seconds) and every internal name follow. Nothing about the Signal platform itself changes.
limitations: This is an internal rename with no behaviour change: [cognition] still ships mode = "off", and every wake rule, brake and default is exactly as it was the day before.
